annotation.title_clean: 工业和信息化部 市场监管总局关于进一步加强智能网联汽车产品准入、召回及软件在线升级管理的通知
annotation.title_en: Notice of the Ministry of Industry and Information Technology and the State Administration for Market Regulation on Further Strengthening the Administration of Admission, Recall and Over-the-Air Software Upgrades of Intelligent Connected Vehicle Products
annotation.authors_or_issuer: 工业和信息化部; 国家市场监督管理总局
annotation.summary_en: Joint MIIT and SAMR notice (2025) tightening market admission, recall and over-the-air upgrade management for intelligent connected vehicles with combined driver-assistance systems. It requires technical parameter filing, sandbox testing, incident reporting, OTA upgrade registration and manufacturer responsibility for quality and safety.
key_provisions_or_claims: Manufacturers bear primary responsibility for product quality and safety, including testing and notification duties.
Combined driver-assistance and OTA parameters added to the vehicle technical parameter table, under admission and production-consistency management.
Deepened safety sandbox supervision with in-depth testing of driver-assistance systems.
Mandatory reporting of driver-assistance failures and collisions to MIIT and SAMR.
OTA upgrades must be filed; those changing key parameters or autonomous driving functions require prior permission.
